note: Swedbank Estonia's fee information document (31 August 2026): under account management it lists opening and closing the account free and no fee for keeping it; payments are priced per transaction (0.16 euros an electronic payment within the bank, free up to 25 and from 65), which isn't modelled. Residents of countries outside the EU, the EEA, the UK and Switzerland pay 250 euros once to have their documents reviewed, not modelled.
